name: Beef Pulao
description: Aromatic Pakistani beef pulao cooked in seasoned beef yakhni with fragrant basmati rice and whole spices.
ingredients: 4 cups basmati rice, rinsed and soaked for 30 minutes
method: Put the beef, half the onion, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, half the whole spices, salt and 7 cups water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until the beef is tender.
Remove the beef and strain the yakhni. Measure the stock so the liquid added to the rice can be controlled.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and fry the remaining onions until golden. Add the remaining ginger-garlic paste and whole spices, then add the cooked beef and fry for several minutes.
Lower the heat and stir in the whisked yogurt and green chilies. Cook until the masala is glossy and excess moisture has reduced.
Drain the soaked rice and add it gently. Pour in enough hot yakhni for the rice to cook, adjusting for the basmati variety, and taste the liquid for salt.
Bring to a boil and cook uncovered until most liquid is absorbed and steam holes appear. Cover tightly, reduce to very low heat and cook on dum for 15–20 minutes.
Turn off the heat, rest covered for 10 minutes, then fluff gently and serve.
tips: Use strained beef yakhni rather than plain water for the characteristic pulao flavour.
Basmati varieties absorb different amounts of liquid, so add stock according to the rice rather than automatically using all of it.
Avoid repeated stirring after adding rice so the grains stay intact.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate covered for up to 2 days. Reheat until the beef and rice are steaming hot throughout.
